_about: The blog as the stand-in serves it. 'posts' is every post file in the pretend repository; 'reviews' says where each stands on the superadmin's review desk (live, waiting, update, rejected). Readers (GET /api/blog) get only the posts whose review has a 'published' date. 'how-to-buy-a-data-plan' uses every kind of block and inline mark the website can draw, including the live hostel list. Two posts have a cover illustration ('coverSvg': shapes only, 1200 x 630); readers and the review desk only see covers when the scenario's 'covers' knob says so.

posts.title: How to buy a data plan
posts.summary: Pick your hostel, choose a plan and pay. Your code shows on screen straight away.

blocks.text: Buying internet for your room takes about a minute. You need **your email** and a way to pay, and *nothing else*.
Find your hostel
Start from [the hostel list](/hostels) or pick yours below. Every hostel we serve is on this list:
Choose a plan

items: Device plans cover three or five devices.
Unlimited plans run for a set number of days.
TV plans are tied to one television.

blocks.text: What you pay
The figure on the plan is the figure you pay. Read the [terms](https://lodgeinternet.com/legal/terms) if you want the detail, or see [this outside page](https://example.org/elsewhere).
A link dressed up to look like one of our pages, such as [this look-alike](//example.org/plans) or [this one](/\example.org), is shown as plain words too.

items: Keep the page open until your code appears.

blocks.text: Keep the page open until your code is on screen.
Your code is a short number such as `48213907`. Type it on the hostel Wi-Fi sign-in page.

posts.title: What happens when you pay
posts.summary: We hold a code for you before you pay, so the one you paid for is always the one you get.
posts.note: Rewritten after the wallet launch: the middle section is new.

blocks.text: When you tap Pay, we first set one code aside with your name on it. Only then does the payment page open.
If you close the payment page
The code goes back on the shelf for the next person. Nothing is charged.

posts.title: How we hold your code
posts.summary: A look at the reservation step that stops two people buying the last code.

blocks.text: Two students tapping Pay in the same second used to race for the last code. Now the first tap wins it and the second is told straight away.
reservation_id, expires = await reserve_code_for_pool(pool=pool, uid=uid)

posts.title: Your wallet, explained
posts.summary: Top up once by bank transfer, then buy any plan in one tap.
posts.note: Please check the part about account numbers reads clearly.

blocks.text: Your wallet is money you keep with Lodge Internet for buying plans. It comes with a bank account number that is yours alone.
Topping up
Send any amount to your account number from your bank app. It lands in your wallet within a minute or two.

posts.title: Sharing a plan with roommates
posts.summary: One plan can cover three or five devices. Here is how to split it fairly.

blocks.text: A five-device plan is the cheapest way for a full room to get online. One person buys it and shares the code.
